text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As an eldest daughter, Ines Fujin<n>feels a lot of
responsibility for her<n>family. Even while training for
the<n>races she loves so much, she works<n>part-time
jobs to support her little<n>sisters' dreams as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Feeling guilty for indulging in her<n>desire to race, she
works hard for her<n>family, and to fund her sisters'
dance<n>lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin tells me she wants to<n>continue working
part-time jobs even<n>after her debut in the Twinkle
Series.<n>It seems she's determined to keep<n>doing
her best both on the track and<n>at work.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The path ahead might get tough, but<n>she doesn't
want to neglect any of<n>the things that matter to her.
I swear<n>that I'll do all I can to support her!
